method.kernel: LDI r16,1; LDI r17,0x55; loop: ADD r18,r16; EOR r19,r17; INC r20; RJMP loop. The loop retires4instructions per5CPUcycles. No timer/PWM is enabled.
method.timing: Serial warmed Node runs. Fresh memory per run, construction and input submission outside timers, no profiling/forcedGC/CPUaffinity. Rotate/reverse case order between trials. V8/GC/other host load remain in samples.
method.direct: One public run(N) call. Native full-device cases include the real peripheral scheduler and IRQ checks even with unused devices. Legacy translated is the limited historical runtime, not equal hardware coverage. These are throughput tests, not exclusive CPU-function instrumentation.
method.clock: Only public capturePhysical calls are timed. 25ms by default, 48kHz mono constant-low output. Full native CPU, scheduler, source/PB3 pin capture, native integration and wrapper copying remain coupled. Descriptors are submitted before timing, every supplied CLKI transition is still serviced.
method.divider: Both physical modes start D1 then receive the same protected CLKPR request at time0. One old source cycle precedes the selected new divisor, avoiding a difference in initial divider phase.
method.validation: Independent program/count/register/cycle assertions, no faults, exact PCM=-1, deterministic per-case CPU snapshots and byte-for-byte CPU equivalence between internal physical source and matching CLKI waveform at each frequency/divisor. Compilation/construction/hashing/assertions are outside execution timers.
method.limits: Node host results, not browser/AudioWorklet latency or silicon measurements. Constant-output kernel is not representative of music; use benchmark-device.mjs for firmware/PWM/DSP.
